verifier_b.independent_derivation_or_calculation: Masses m1 and m2 on ideal string over pulley of mass M, radius R. MOI of pulley I = 1/2 M R^2. Tensions T1 and T2. Equations: m1 g - T1 = m1 a (if m1 moving down). T2 - m2 g = m2 a. Torque on pulley: (T1 - T2) R = I alpha = 1/2 M R^2 (a/R). So T1 - T2 = 1/2 M a. Adding equations: (m1 - m2) g = (m1 + m2 + M/2) a. a = (m1 - m2)g / (m1 + m2 + M/2).
findings: First-principles derivation matched claimed theorem exactly.
